note:
ROUND 2 of the medical explainer set for /pages/copper-peptide-research, blocks f1, f2, f3. Round 1 (block-copper-peptide-research-medical) is KEPT, not superseded — Malcolm called it 'the right direction'. This round changes one thing.

MALCOLM'S NOTE, 2026-08-25: 'the copper peptide particles look a little static. can we show the areas where the copper peptide particles touch the skin cells that they activate the skin? so add more of an activating dynamic - with a glow or cells becoming more strong?'

HE IS RIGHT AND THE DIAGNOSIS IS PRECISE. In round 1 the actives FLOAT NEAR things and never touch anything. Every droplet hangs in clear space; nothing in the frame is different because the droplet is there. The picture shows an active in the vicinity of skin, not an active doing something to skin.

RESEARCHED THE CONVENTION rather than inventing one (Malcolm's suggestion). The beauty-industry medical-explainer genre carries activation as a SEQUENCE, not a state: contact -> absorption -> visible response. A representative description of the genre's stock animation: bright spheres descend onto the skin layer, PENETRATE AND ARE ABSORBED, and the layer then visibly smooths and plumps, with the structures beneath expanding. Sources consulted: polygonmedical.com/skin-care, voka.io/3d-medical-animation-services/dermatology, and a Dreamstime collagen-regeneration animation listing.

FOUR DEVICES CARRY IT, and all four are now written into every slot:
  1. CONTACT. The active is touching or partly merged into a cell or fibre, never hovering near it. At least one is caught mid-absorption, its surface flattening where it meets the membrane.
  2. BLOOM. A soft bright halo blooms at the exact point of contact — the brightest thing in the frame.
  3. PROPAGATION. Light travels OUTWARD from each contact point, along the fibre columns or from cell to cell, as glowing veins that fade with distance.
  4. RESPONSE GRADIENT. Structures nearest a contact point are plumper, rounder, better defined and brighter; the same structures far from any contact are flatter, thinner and duller. Continuous falloff across the frame.

THE GRADIENT IS NOT A BEFORE-AND-AFTER, and the distinction is a claims one, not an aesthetic one. A split frame compares one person's skin at two times and asserts a measured result. A continuous falloff around a contact point depicts a MECHANISM propagating through tissue, which is what the cited copy describes. The 'no before and after split / no split screen / no dividing line' negatives therefore stay in force on all three slots.

EACH SLOT'S ACTIVATION IS HELD TO WHAT ITS OWN CITATION SAYS:
  f1  Pickart & Margolina 2018 — 'role in the skin's natural support of collagen, elastin and glycosaminoglycan production'. So: fibre columns thicken and light up near the active. Mechanism.
  f2  Kang 2009 — 'Increased activity of skin-renewal cells (keratinocytes) and basal-cell markers ... in lab skin models'. The copy literally says increased activity of the BASAL cells, so the activation is concentrated in the LOWEST row and one or two cells there are dividing. Faithful, and specific to the study.
  f3  Miller 2006 — self-reported SATISFACTION over 12 weeks, not a measured change. So f3 gets contact and absorption at the surface and a soft bloom beneath, and still NO plumping comparison, no smoothing sequence, no split. The activation here is arrival, not result.

GLOW MUST READ ORGANIC, NOT ELECTRICAL. Asking six engines for 'energy' invites lightning, sparks, neon and laser beams, none of which belong in a cosmetics explainer. Negated by name: lightning, electric arc, sparks, fireworks, starburst, laser, neon.

EVERYTHING ELSE IS UNCHANGED FROM ROUND 1 and is deliberate: high-key pastel ground, soft near-shadowless light, rounded glossy forms, bubbles; pearl-white tissue with a powder-blue cast; the active in Clinical blue 014EB1 with copper B87333 inside; pink negated by name because skin-section CGI defaults to it; no double helix, because PDRN's tile owns the helix; no face on f2, because that study is in-vitro. Square 2048x2048, measured off the live DOM. CLASS B, FLUX.2 in the run — it refused f3 on a content check in round 1, which is a genuine API content_policy_violation and may recur.

slots.title: f1 · the active meets the scaffold — contact, bloom, fibres strengthening
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium cosmetics advertising: smooth candy-like CGI, every form rounded and glossy, rendered high-key on a pale luminous background. Square format.

The scene looks along a shallow space between two beds of soft rounded pebble-like forms. Standing between them are five or six tall smooth columns, each a bundle of glossy ribbons gathered inward at the waist into a slender hourglass, pearl white with a cool powder-blue sheen.

THE SUBJECT IS THE MOMENT OF CONTACT. Two translucent droplets of clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, each holding a small cluster of polished copper spheres, colour hex B87333, are pressed directly against the middle columns — not floating near them but touching, their undersides flattened and beginning to sink into the surface where they meet, one already half-absorbed and losing its outline into the ribbon. At each point of contact a soft warm-white halo blooms outward, the brightest light in the frame.

From each contact point, light runs OUTWARD along the ribbons of that column as glowing veins that spread up and down its length and fade as they travel. The columns that are touched are visibly thicker, rounder and more defined than the others, their ribbons drawn taut and full and lit from within; the columns furthest from any contact are noticeably slimmer, softer-edged and duller, and the change from one to the other is gradual across the frame. The pebble beds directly above and below a lit column are plumper and brighter too.

One further droplet is still descending, elongated and caught mid-fall with a faint soft trail behind it. Clear glassy bubbles drift in the space. Soft diffuse light with gentle rim highlights and almost no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far columns dissolving into pale blue-white haze. Clean, minimal, uncluttered. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: f2 · lab tissue — the active reaching the lowest row, which responds
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium cosmetics advertising: smooth candy-like CGI, every form rounded and glossy, rendered high-key on a pale luminous background. Square format.

A cross-section through a small piece of laboratory-grown tissue, seen from the side, isolated with clean empty space around it so it reads as a specimen rather than part of a body. It is built of many stacked horizontal rows of plump, smooth, translucent pebble-like cells, pearl white with a cool powder-blue cast, each glowing softly from within.

THE SUBJECT IS THE LOWEST ROW RESPONDING. Three small translucent capsules of clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, each holding a cluster of polished copper spheres, colour hex B87333, have reached the bottom of the stack and are pressed into the cells of the lowest row — in contact, their surfaces flattened against the membranes, one already partly absorbed and dissolving into the cell it touches. At each contact a soft warm-white halo blooms, the brightest light in the frame.

The cells of that lowest row nearest a capsule are markedly rounder, plumper and brighter than any other cell in the tissue, their membranes crisp and full and lit from inside; two of them are pinched into a figure-of-eight in the act of becoming two. Along the row, cells further from a capsule are progressively flatter and duller, so the response fades smoothly with distance. From the lit cells a soft glow rises upward through the rows above, weakening as it climbs, so the upper rows are faintly warmed but plainly less affected.

A few clear glassy bubbles rest between rows. Soft diffuse light from above, gentle rim highlights, almost no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, edges dissolving into pale blue-white haze. Clean, minimal, uncluttered. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: f3 · the surface — droplets landing and being taken in
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium cosmetics advertising: smooth candy-like CGI, every form rounded and glossy, rendered high-key on a pale luminous background. Square format.

Seen from the side, a smooth continuous surface layer sweeps across the frame in one gentle undulating wave, glossy and slightly translucent like poured glaze, its crest catching a long soft highlight. Beneath it lies a tightly packed bed of plump rounded translucent spheres in even rows, pearl white with a cool powder-blue cast. The surface is smooth, even and refined along its whole length.

THE SUBJECT IS ABSORPTION. Several translucent droplets of clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, descend in loose vertical trails, some still falling and elongated into teardrops with faint soft trails behind them. One droplet — a clear capsule holding a cluster of polished copper spheres, colour hex B87333 — has already landed on the crest and is sinking INTO the glaze, its upper half still domed above the surface and its lower half lost inside it, with a soft ring-shaped ripple spreading outward across the surface from where it entered. A second droplet rests flattened on the surface a little further along, mid-merge.

Directly beneath the point of entry, a soft warm-white bloom glows up through the translucent layer, and the two or three spheres immediately under it are brighter and press up more fully against the surface than their neighbours, the effect fading gently outward within a few spheres either side.

The upper third of the frame is soft empty pale gradient, luminous and clean. Soft diffuse light, gentle rim highlights, almost no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Clean, minimal, uncluttered. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
